rotationPrinciple.statement: Rotating to a crop that is not a host of the same pests and diseases breaks their cycles. This tool uses 'different botanical family' as a rough stand-in for 'not a host'; the sources below say 'unrelated or non-susceptible hosts' and 'nonhost crop', not 'different family', and host ranges differ by pest.

quotes.text: Rotate with unrelated or non-susceptible hosts

value.conditions: Credit to a following WHEAT crop after many years of alfalfa was plowed down, estimated at 3 California sites (Davis, Kearney, Tulelake), field trials roughly 2011-2015. depletionFractionP.note: p is the average fraction of Total Available Soil Water that can be depleted from the root zone before moisture stress (reduction in ET) occurs (FAO-56 Chapter 8, Eq. 83 text). Table 22 values apply for ETc of about 5 mm/day (footnote 2: p = p table 22 + 0.04 (5 - ETc)). Used here ONLY as a proxy for drought tolerance: a higher p means more of the stored water can be used before stress; it is not a measured drought rating.
